Ride the wind &amp; experience the thrill.</p></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-16f360a elementor-widget__width-auto elementor-widget elementor-widget-button" data-id="16f360a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:&quot;100&quot;}" data-widget_type="button.default">

data-widget_type="html.default"><style></style><section class="mjs-facts" aria-label="Quick facts"><h2>Jeneponto kitesurfing: quick facts</h2><p class="mjs-sub">Everything you need to know before your kitesurf trip to Jeneponto.</p><dl><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Wind season</dt><dd>May to October, steady south-east trade wind</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Wind strength</dt><dd>20+ knot average, often 35+ knots from July to September</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Kite days</dt><dd>Over 80% of days in season</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>The spot</dt><dd>2 km flat, shallow lagoon with on-shore wind</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Level</dt><dd>Beginners to advanced, private and group lessons</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Gear</dt><dd>F-ONE kites and boards for rent, 8m most used</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Getting here</dt><dd>80 km from Makassar airport (UPG), about 3h by private transfer</dd></div><div class="mjs-fact"><dt>Where to stay</dt><dd>Batikite Resort (12 beachfront bungalows) or Salmira Beach Resort (6 rooms)</dd></div></dl></section></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c842cc9 e-flex e-con-boxed elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget-tablet__width-inherit elementor-widget-mobile__width-inherit elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="f840461" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:400,&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;}" data-widget_type="heading.default"><h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Enjoy the thrill of a wonderful kitesurf Adventure In Indonesia</h2></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c16b19c elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget-tablet__width-initial elementor-widget-mobile__width-inherit elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c16b19c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:500,&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default"><p>Jeneponto is a haven for kitesurfing enthusiasts seeking the ultimate adrenaline rush. With its consistent winds, safe lagoon, and warm temperatures, Jeneponto offers the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable kitesurfing experience in Indonesia.</p></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0e8be3c e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="0e8be3c" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-84d62e5 e-transform bdt-backdrop-filter-yes elementor-widget__width-inherit bdt-icon-type-icon elementor-position-top bdt-icon-effect-none bdt-filter-backdrop elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-bdt-advanced-icon-box" data-id="84d62e5" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:-15,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:700,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="bdt-advanced-icon-box.default"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon">
<span class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon-wrap">
<svg></svg></span></div><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-content"><h3 class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-title ep-title-">
<span >
Windiest kitesurf spot in Indonesia			</span></h3><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-description"><p>Jeneponto revealed Indonesia as a must-do destination for kitesurfing. The south of Sulawesi enjoys strong &amp; consistent trade winds from May to October up to 35+ knots at peak season. This mind-blowing wind statistics with &gt;80% kite days are the guarantee of making the best of your kitesurf holidays. Jeneponto is even ranked in the top 10 worldwide for the peak months.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c497fa9 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c497fa9" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a198387 e-transform bdt-backdrop-filter-yes elementor-widget__width-inherit bdt-icon-type-icon elementor-position-top bdt-icon-effect-none bdt-filter-backdrop elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-bdt-advanced-icon-box" data-id="a198387" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:-15,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:700,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="bdt-advanced-icon-box.default"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon">
<span class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon-wrap">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="lu lu-waves"></i></span></div><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-content"><h3 class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-title ep-title-">
<span >
Exciting kiteboarding playground			</span></h3><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-description"><p>Uncharted kitesurf spot, you will enjoy a safe &amp; shallow lagoon away from the crowd. The spot works both at high &amp; mid tides with the lagoon moving, but the fun remains the same. Flat and shallow, the spot is perfect for beginners and freestylers. For big air lovers, we have strong winds &amp; small kickers. Whatever style &amp; level, there is something for everyone to enjoy!</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7201253 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="7201253" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-42525aa e-transform bdt-backdrop-filter-yes elementor-widget__width-inherit bdt-icon-type-icon elementor-position-top bdt-icon-effect-none bdt-filter-backdrop elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-bdt-advanced-icon-box" data-id="42525aa" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:-15,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:700,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="bdt-advanced-icon-box.default"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon">
<span class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon-wrap">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="lu lu-sun"></i></span></div><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-content"><h3 class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-title ep-title-">
<span >
Stunning weather			</span></h3><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-description"><p>Unlike most of Asian kitesurf spots, wind is blowing in Indonesia during the dry season. It means deep blue sky and no rain at all. Temperature with the wind is a comfortable 28°C ideal to ride in bikini or board-short with a rashguard.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-972c164 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="972c164" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0a4f28f e-transform bdt-backdrop-filter-yes bdt-icon-type-image elementor-widget__width-inherit elementor-widget-tablet__width-inherit elementor-position-top bdt-icon-effect-none bdt-filter-backdrop elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-bdt-advanced-icon-box" data-id="0a4f28f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:-15,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:700,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="bdt-advanced-icon-box.default"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon">
<span class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon-wrap"><img data-lazyloaded="1" src="data:," decoding="async" width="124" height="119" data-src="https://indonesiakitesurfing.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/White-logo-F-One-transparent-1.png" class="attachment-full size-full" alt="Kitesurf center by F-One" loading="eager" /><noscript><img decoding="async" width="124" height="119" src="https://indonesiakitesurfing.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/White-logo-F-One-transparent-1.png" class="attachment-full size-full" alt="Kitesurf center by F-One" loading="eager" /></noscript>				</span></div><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-content"><h3 class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-title ep-title-">
<span >
Kitesurf center by F-One			</span></h3><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-description"><p>Our kite school is equipped with worldwide leading brands for rental &amp; lessons. Designed for all-round performance, the Bandit kite model is a perfect fit for all levels. Kite gears are regularly renewed for your comfort &amp; safety.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d8af121 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="d8af121" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a04de5f e-transform bdt-backdrop-filter-yes elementor-widget-tablet__width-inherit bdt-icon-type-icon elementor-position-top bdt-icon-effect-none bdt-filter-backdrop elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-bdt-advanced-icon-box" data-id="a04de5f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:-15,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;zoomOutUp&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:700,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_hover_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}" data-widget_type="bdt-advanced-icon-box.default"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box"><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon">
<span class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-icon-wrap">
<i aria-hidden="true" class="ri ri-roadster-fill"></i></span></div><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-content"><h3 class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-title ep-title-">
<span >
Easy access			</span></h3><div class="bdt-ep-advanced-icon-box-description"><p>Our little paradise is located within 3 hours from the Makassar, the East-Indonesia capital. Its international airport provides daily flights from all Indonesian main cities and  international hubs like Singapore &amp; Kuala Lumpur.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div Un accueil très agréable, nous nous sommes vite sentis les bienvenus ! Le personnel est très chaleureux, rigolo et toujours présent avec le sourire ! Les propriétaires sont très présents, à l’écoute, prennent souvent des nouvelles. Nous pouvons voir qu’ils aiment ce qu’ils font, et prennent sincèrement le temps de découvrir leurs clients. Un coup de cœur pour Alice, qui est un vrai rayon de soleil, pétillante et souriante à toute heure de la journée ! Al, le manager, est également très présent, sympathique et prend le temps de discuter avec ses clients. Côté kite, beau spot, vent régulier, kite tous les jours sans faute, entraide, tout le monde se respecte sur l’eau, et même en dehors. Nous avons vraiment l’impression de former une belle équipe, l’équipe du Jeneponto Kitesurfing hôtel 😉. Je recommande Jeneponto Kitesurfing à toute personne amatrice de kite, mais qui souhaite également une bonne ambiance au sein de l’hôtel. J’ai vraiment apprécié ce séjour, grâce aux belles personnes rencontrées qui font parties des belles découvertes de ce voyage, mais également dans l’ensemble. Tout était parfait ! Merci à toute l’équipe ! À une prochaine fois,&#010;Stéphanie et Marine.</div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Hide" data-open-text="Read more"></span> </div> </div>  </div> <div class="ti-controls-line"> <div class="dot"></div> </div> </div>    <div class="ti-verified-by ti-verified-by-row" data-style="1"> <div class="ti-inner"> Verified by Trustindex <span class="ti-info-icon"></span> <div class="ti-disclaimer">Trustindex verified badge is the Universal Symbol of Trust.
